from common import *
import argparse,gc,traceback,shutil
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import rankdata
from backtest.scripts.maintenance import experiment_harness as native
from backtest.models import regime_adapt as models
from backtest.scripts.train import train_regime_arm as tr

NATIVE=BASE/'docs/harness-state.json'
def event(kind,**kw):
    s=native.inspect_state(NATIVE,repo_root=ROOT,check_drift=(kind=='fit_start'))
    return native.append_event(NATIVE,dict(type=kind,**kw),expected_revision=s['revision'],repo_root=ROOT)

def prepare():
    prepared=read(PREVEX/'configs/prepared-inputs.json')
    prior=read(PREVEX/'docs/weekly-h5-four-T-s42-a1-inputs.json')
    m=read(VALID)['blocks']['frame'];path=VALID.parent/m['path'];check({**m,'path':str(path)})
    data=pd.read_pickle(path)
    frame=data['frame']; tradable=data['tradable']
    del data
    mask=frame.index.get_level_values('datetime')<=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-23')
    frame=frame.loc[mask];tradable=tradable.reindex(frame.index)
    assert tr.frame_signature(frame)==prior['validation'] and tr.frame_signature(tradable)==prior['tradable']
    y=frame['label','LABEL0'].astype('float64');assert np.isfinite(y).all() and y.index.is_monotonic_increasing
    size=y.groupby(level='datetime').transform('count')
    twice_rank=y.groupby(level='datetime').rank(method='average')*2
    bins=((10*twice_rank.to_numpy().astype('int64')-1)//(2*size.to_numpy())).astype(np.int8)
    assert bins.min()==0 and bins.max()==9
    vals=np.array(read(TARGET_AUDIT)['h5']['scores_float32'],dtype=np.float32)
    frame['label','LABEL0']=vals[bins]
    labels=day_labels().reindex(frame.index.get_level_values('datetime'))
    assert labels.notna().all()
    receipt={}
    for v in VARIANTS:
        df=frame.iloc[np.flatnonzero(labels.eq(v).to_numpy())]
        assert df.index.get_level_values('datetime').nunique()==prepared['eval_day_counts'][v]
        p=TMP/f'valid-{v}.pkl';df.to_pickle(p)
        receipt[v]={'frame':tr.frame_signature(df),'temp_file':fingerprint(p),'ten_bin_counts':{str(i):int((df['label','LABEL0']==val).sum()) for i,val in enumerate(vals)}}
        del df
    write(BASE/'docs/validation-grade.json',dict(validation_recipe='all finite frozen H5 labels, midrank, ceil(10*average_rank/N)-1, same training affine; split after grading',raw_panel=prior['validation'],styles=receipt))
    print('Prepared validation subsets',flush=True)

class DailyRanks:
    def __init__(self,frame):
        index=frame.index
        dates=index.get_level_values('datetime').to_numpy()
        self.bounds=np.r_[0,np.flatnonzero(dates[1:]!=dates[:-1])+1,len(dates)]
        assert np.diff(self.bounds).min()>=20
        self.raw_y=frame['label','LABEL0'].to_numpy()
        self.target=[]
        for lo,hi in zip(self.bounds[:-1],self.bounds[1:]):
            r=rankdata(self.raw_y[lo:hi]);r-=r.mean()
            self.target.append(r/np.sqrt(r@r))
        self.history=[]
    def __call__(self,pred,label,index):
        assert np.isfinite(pred).all() and np.array_equal(self.raw_y,label)
        vals=[]; revvals=[];boundary=0
        for lo,hi,yr in zip(self.bounds[:-1],self.bounds[1:],self.target):
            x=pred[lo:hi]
            rank=rankdata(x);rank-=rank.mean();norm=np.sqrt(rank@rank)
            reverse=rankdata(x[::-1]);reverse-=reverse.mean()
            rn=np.sqrt(reverse@reverse)
            if norm:
                vals.append(float((rank@yr)/norm))
                revvals.append(float((reverse@yr[::-1])/rn))
            top=np.partition(x,len(x)-4)[-4:];top.sort()
            boundary+=int(top[0]==top[1])
        score=float(np.mean(vals));rscore=float(np.mean(revvals));assert np.isfinite(score) and abs(score-rscore)<1e-12
        if not self.history:
            from backtest.models.rankic_early_stop import mean_daily_rank_ic
            verified=mean_daily_rank_ic(pred,label,index)
            assert abs(score-verified)<1e-12,(score,verified)
            self.reference_error=abs(score-verified)
        self.history.append(dict(round=len(self.history)+1,rankic=score,reversed_rankic=rscore,finite_days=len(vals),top3_boundary_tie_days=boundary))
        return score

def fit_style(v):
    import qlib
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=1)
    prep=read(PREVEX/'configs/prepared-inputs.json');sub=prep['subsets'][v];check(sub['target'])
    y=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/sub['target']['path'])
    fm=read(FEATURE);parts=[]
    for year in range(2004,2021):
        b=fm['blocks'][str(year)];p=FEATURE.parent/b['path'];check({**b,'path':str(p)})
        f=pd.read_pickle(p); target=y[y.index.get_level_values('datetime').year==year];assert target.index.isin(f.index).all()
        x=f.reindex(target.index);x.columns=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([['feature'],f.columns]);x['label','LABEL0']=target.to_numpy();parts.append(x)
    train=pd.concat(parts,copy=False);del parts,x,f;gc.collect()
    assert train.index.equals(y.index) and hash_array(y.to_numpy())==sub['label_sha256']
    w=models.compose_day_weights(train.index,pd.Series(np.ones(len(train))),models.load_day_weights(str(WEIGHTS)))
    assert hash_array(w.to_numpy())==sub['weight_sha256']
    xs=hash_array(train['feature'].to_numpy());prev=read(PREVEX/'docs'/f'weekly-h5-four-{v}-s42-a1-inputs.json')
    assert xs==prev['feature_array_sha256'] and tr.frame_signature(train)==prev['training']
    validrec=read(BASE/'docs/validation-grade.json')['styles'][v];check(validrec['temp_file'])
    valid=pd.read_pickle(TMP/f'valid-{v}.pkl')
    assert tr.frame_signature(valid)==validrec['frame']
    del w,y;gc.collect()
    for seed in SEEDS:
        history=read(PROGRESS)['jobs']
        if any(j['variant']==v and j['seed']==seed and j['status']=='succeeded' for j in history):continue
        attempt=1+len([j for j in history if j['variant']==v and j['seed']==seed])
        job=f'{STAGE}-{v}-s{seed}-a{attempt}';sess=f'wkric_20261114_{v.lower()}_s{seed}'
        out=BASE/'docs'/f'{job}.json'
        params=dict(tr.FROZEN_SINGLE_KWARGS);params['early_stopping_rounds']=50
        model=models.RegimeSingleLGBMModel(protocol_id='regime-adapt-v1',valid_dates_csv=None,day_weights_csv=str(WEIGHTS),seed=seed,es_metric='daily_rank_ic',**params)
        assert model.params==read(PREVEX/'docs'/f'weekly-h5-four-{v}-s{seed}-a1.json')['parameters']
        ranks=DailyRanks(valid)
        event('fit_start',job_id=job,exp_id=EID,seed=seed,label_horizon=5,command=[sys.executable,__file__,'fit',v,str(seed)])
        start=time.time()
        status=dict(variant=v,seed=seed,job_id=job,session=sess,status='running',started_at=start)
        prog=read(PROGRESS);prog['jobs'].append(status);write(PROGRESS,prog)
        try:
            old=models.mean_daily_rank_ic;models.mean_daily_rank_ic=ranks
            try:model.fit_prepared(train,valid)
            finally:models.mean_daily_rank_ic=old
            hist=ranks.history;res=model.rankic_evals_result[0]
            rg=lambda k:int(np.argmax([r[k] for r in hist])+1)
            best=rg('rankic');assert res['best_iteration']==rg('reversed_rankic')==best
            assert len(hist)==min(200,best+50)
            su=dict(arm='m0',model='single',seed=seed,label_horizon=5,label_expr='Ref($close,-6)/Ref($close,-1)-1',es_metric='daily_rank_ic',es_valid_source='eval_window',label_encoding='H5 quantile10',training_regime=v,es_scoring_scope=v,rankic_evals=model.rankic_evals_result,frozen_hyperparams='same as frozen weekly H5 four experts',fit_seconds=time.time()-start)
            sd=tr.save_session('m0',seed,sess,model,su);meta=read(sd/'meta.json');meta.update(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),owner_experiment=EID);write(sd/'meta.json',meta)
            model_path=sd/'run_01/artifacts_root/artifacts/trained_model';mref=fingerprint(model_path)
            write(out,dict(job_id=job,variant=v,seed=seed,session=sess,model=mref,parameters=model.params,early_stopping=res,rounds=hist,official_first_round_error=ranks.reference_error,best_iteration=best,reverse_best_iteration=rg('reversed_rankic'),best_top3_ties=hist[best-1]['top3_boundary_tie_days'],max_order_error=max(abs(r['rankic']-r['reversed_rankic']) for r in hist),fit_seconds=time.time()-start,training_reference=fingerprint(PREVEX/'docs'/f'weekly-h5-four-{v}-s{seed}-a1-inputs.json'),features_sha256=xs,label_sha256=sub['label_sha256'],weights_sha256=sub['weight_sha256'],validation=validrec['frame']))
            event('fit_result',job_id=job,outcome='succeeded',evidence=[str(out),str(model_path)])
            prog=read(PROGRESS);prog['jobs'][-1].update(status='succeeded',finished_at=time.time());write(PROGRESS,prog)
            print('fit',v,seed,'best',best,'rounds',len(hist),'rankic',res['best_score'],'duration',time.time()-start,flush=True)
        except BaseException:
            err=BASE/'docs'/f'{job}-failed.json';write(err,dict(job=job,traceback=traceback.format_exc()));event('fit_result',job_id=job,outcome='failed',evidence=[str(err)]);prog=read(PROGRESS);prog['jobs'][-1]['status']='failed';write(PROGRESS,prog);raise
        del model,ranks;gc.collect()

def pipeline():
    for p in ['common','setup','run','infer','evaluate']:save_source(TMP/f'{p}.py')
    def execute(argv,log):
        with (BASE/'docs'/log).open('a') as f:subprocess.run([sys.executable,*map(str,argv)],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,cwd=ROOT)
    if not (BASE/'docs/validation-grade.json').exists():execute([__file__,'prepare'],'prepare.log')
    for v in VARIANTS:execute([__file__,'fit',v],f'train-{v}.log')
    for year in range(2020,2027):
        if not (BASE/'docs'/f'inference-{year}.json').exists():execute([TMP/'infer.py',year],f'infer-{year}.log')
    for v in VARIANTS:
        if not (BASE/'metrics'/f'{v}.json').exists():execute([TMP/'evaluate.py',v],f'eval-{v}.log')

if __name__=='__main__':
    if len(sys.argv)==1:pipeline()
    elif sys.argv[1]=='prepare':prepare()
    elif sys.argv[1]=='fit':fit_style(sys.argv[2])
